summary: Iteration 14 — Affiliate program (leaderboard + badges + admin settings foundation) fully verified. 16/16 new backend tests pass, 9/9 referral regression tests pass, and all required HelpPage UI behaviors confirmed across unauth, auth-with-0-referrals, and auth-with-1-referral states.
backend_tests_covered: GET /api/affiliate/settings — public, returns default settings with reward_type='credits', qualifying_event='signup'

PUT /api/admin/affiliate/settings as super-admin (mongo flip is_super_admin=true + re-login) → 200, persists, public GET reflects update; snapshot+restore around each write so default state is preserved
PUT with commission_percent=120 → 400 'must be between 0 and 100'
GET /api/referrals/leaderboard — public, returns sorted desc, name (not email/code), limit clamped to [1, 50], multi-inviter ordering correct
GET /api/auth/me/badge after 1 real referral → badge.key='ambassador', label='Ambassador', count=1
GET /api/auth/me/badge after 5 fake referees inserted directly in mongo → badge.key='advocate', label='Author Advocate', count=5; cleanup deletes fake users
Regression: /auth/register, /auth/me, /auth/me/referrals still work and return referral_code
frontend_tests_covered: Unauth /help: leaderboard-card visible with 9 rows; first row rank '1' has amber-100/amber-300 classes; first entry shows real name 'Alice the Inviter' (not code/email); help-toc-leaderboard visible; help-toc-share NOT rendered; referral-card NOT rendered

Auth user with 0 referrals: referral-card renders, referral-badge NOT rendered, program-rules card renders with 'Reward type: credits' and 'Qualifying event: signup' from /affiliate/settings, help-toc-share renders
Auth user with 1 invite via referral_code: referral-badge renders with text 'Your badge / Ambassador / Earned for inviting 1 author.' (singular form correct)
critical_code_review_comments: DEFAULT_AFFILIATE_SETTINGS has enabled=True by default, which is fine for tracking-only mode (commission_percent=0). Consider future-proofing: when commission_percent>0, payouts would need Stripe Connect — current implementation correctly notes this in a comment.

/api/admin/affiliate/settings has no rate-limiting/audit log. For an owner-only endpoint this is acceptable but a one-line audit log entry per update would be valuable when payout logic is added in the next iteration.
Leaderboard does a per-row find_one for the referrer name (N+1). With limit clamped to 50 this is fine but a single $lookup join would be cleaner long-term.
Badge endpoint recomputes count on every call via count_documents. Cheap for now; consider caching denormalised on User.referral_count when admin UI lands.
is_super_admin must be granted manually via mongo (no UI endpoint to elevate users) — by design per problem statement and the safest pattern. Document this in admin runbook.
test_credentials: All test users registered on the fly with TEST_ prefix and password TestPass123!. Super-admin flag flipped via direct mongo update (MONGO_URL + DB_NAME from env).
seed_data_creation: Tests register 5+ fresh users per run with TEST_ prefix; inserts 5 fake referee docs for the Author Advocate badge test and cleans them up via mongo afterwards. Super-admin settings tests snapshot the affiliate_settings._id='global' doc and restore it after each mutation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter14 fully green. When the admin UI lands in the next iteration, add UI tests for: (1) hiding the admin panel from non-super-admin accounts, (2) toast/error feedback on the three 400 validation paths (invalid reward_type, commission_percent out of range, invalid qualifying_event), (3) live-reflecting the saved values in /help program-rules without a hard refresh. The leaderboard test seeds names like 'LB_Alice', 'LB_Bob', 'Alice the Inviter' — those will accumulate across runs; the test only asserts presence + sort-desc, not exact counts, so it's safe.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — feature addition, no bugs found.
